Suppose we have just one observation in our training data, $$(x_1=1,x_2=2,y=4).$$ Assume that we set the learning rate $$\alpha$$ to $$1$$.

An incomplete version of the gradient descent update equation for $$	heta$$ is shown below. $$	heta_0**{(t)}$$ and $$	heta_1**{(t)}$$ denote the guesses for $$	heta_0$$ and $$	heta_1$$ at timestep $$t$$, respectively.
$$(	heta_0**{(t+1)},	heta_1**{(t+1)})=(	heta_0**{(t)},	heta_1**{(t)})-(A,B)$$

Express A in terms of $$	heta_0**{(t)},$$ $$	heta_1**{(t)},$$ and any necessary constants.
